verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows only adjacent building blocks: an llms.txt index, markdown docs, an OpenAPI schema and a Postman collection. Its own in-product screening and monitoring agents are not an MCP server, and nothing documents an official MCP server or endpoint an external agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
